note: Dualis signs its own side now. The other party is unbound until they bind on their device. Targeted is not signed. Founder plaques stay unpublished.

instruments.name: Look
instruments.terms: Looking is free. A first talk is free. Nothing is bought by opening a card.

instruments.name: Books stay
instruments.terms: Your books stay on this device. Dualis does not take the file. Models may run against a number you keep. Dualis does not keep the number.

instruments.name: Device bind
instruments.terms: The eight-word phrase and the passkey never leave this device. No password file. No seed phrase. Ack is a second bind.

instruments.name: Fuel
instruments.terms: Prepaid time is prepaid time. Fuel credits time on the house rail. Fuel does not open a gated room by itself.

instruments.name: Seat
instruments.terms: A seat is a room for a term. A targeted seat is not a signed deal. A paid seat without a device bind stays held. Held is not open.

instruments.name: Invert or nothing owed
instruments.terms: If the figure cannot be inverted, nothing is owed. Simulation is not treatment. A leftover is a leftover.

instruments.name: Wet-ink limit
instruments.terms: Crown wet-ink is the only wet-ink. A house offer is not Crown wet-ink. A house offer is DualisCapax signing its own side.
